subject: Free Islands Impresses
author: senocular
body: I was actually surprised by this.  Islands are the only DLC I would pay for - that and maybe new game modes.  I certainly don't have interest in buying new cars or skins (liveries), at least not unless they were extremely impressive and awfully cheap (25¢?).

subject: FINALLY!!
author: Mad Wookiee11
body:
Some DLC that isn't just designed to rip us off!  This is way better than how Forza ripps you off for new cars and junk.

Utinam logica falsa tuam philosophiam totam suffodiant!

body: Great news.  Good to know there are some developers who don't want to nickel and dime us.
